cookies.title: Website statistics, only if you agree
cookies.body: I use Google Analytics to understand visits to my software and photography services and contact button clicks. Google Analytics and statistical cookies load only if you accept. Rejecting or closing with X lets you continue without Google Analytics. You can change your choice using cookie preferences in the footer.
cookies.statusAccepted: Current choice: statistics allowed. Closing with X withdraws consent.
cookies.inactive: Google Analytics is currently disabled: it is not loaded and no new statistical cookies are set. Only preferences needed for the website to function remain active.
cookies.storageError: Your browser could not save this choice. Statistics remain disabled on this page. You may be asked again; if you previously accepted, clear this website's browser data to remove the old saved choice too.

privacy.controllerBody: Simone Colli, VAT 03133540348, professional under Italian Law no. 4/2013. For any request about your data you can write to info.dev@simonecolli.com.
privacy.dataBody: The site stores technical preferences for the theme and for cookie choices; the language depends only on the page address and is not stored. With your consent it uses Google Analytics 4 for statistics about page visits and contact clicks, for both software development and photography. For visitors from a country outside the European Union, Cloudflare also collects aggregated statistics without cookies, described below. There are no contact forms: email buttons open your mail application; WhatsApp buttons open a chat on WhatsApp, an external Meta service.
privacy.hostingBody: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.) and pages reach your browser through the Cloudflare network (Cloudflare, Inc.), which sits in between for speed and protection. To deliver the pages, these providers automatically process browsing data: IP address, requested page, date and time, outcome of the request and information about your browser and operating system. If a page fails to load, your browser may send Cloudflare a technical report of the error. These data are used to run the site and protect it from abuse; the legal basis is the legitimate interest in keeping it working and secure (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.cloudflareAnalyticsTitle: Cloudflare statistics for visitors outside the European Union
privacy.cloudflareAnalyticsBody: If you visit the site from a country outside the European Union, Cloudflare adds its own statistics script to the page (Cloudflare Web Analytics, loaded from static.cloudflareinsights.com). For each page viewed, the script measures loading times and sends Cloudflare the page address without parameters, the referring site, the country, the device type, the browser and the operating system. According to Cloudflare, it uses no cookies or other data stored in the browser to track visitors, and the dashboard shows me only aggregated data. Visitors from the European Union do not receive the script. The purpose is to understand how the site is used and how fast it loads; the legal basis is the legitimate interest in measuring its use and performance in aggregate form (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Cloudflare keeps the full data for 7 days and then keeps only a reduced sample; reports can be viewed for the last six months. You can object by writing to the address above, or block the script through your browser settings or extensions.
privacy.fontsBody: Fonts are hosted on this website. Google Analytics is loaded from Google only after consent to statistics. For visitors from a country outside the European Union, Cloudflare adds its own statistics script, described above. External links open services covered by their respective privacy notices.
privacy.emailBody: If you write to me by email or WhatsApp, I will process your address, phone number or contact identifier and the content of your message in order to reply and to manage any resulting professional relationship. Emails sent to the @simonecolli.com addresses pass through Cloudflare's forwarding service and reach my Gmail inboxes (Google), one for development and one for photography, where I keep them for as long as needed to handle the request and any resulting professional relationship. When you open WhatsApp you leave this website: the chat, the prefilled message and any technical data are handled by WhatsApp Ireland Limited/Meta under their own notices. The legal basis is the performance of pre-contractual measures and the legitimate interest in replying.
privacy.rightsBody: You can request access, rectification, erasure, restriction of and objection to the processing of your data, and data portability where applicable, by writing to the address above. You can withdraw consent at any time, without affecting processing carried out before the withdrawal. Requests are free of charge, except for manifestly unfounded or excessive ones, and I reply within one month. If you believe the processing does not comply with the GDPR, you can lodge a complaint with the Italian data protection authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali) or with the supervisory authority of the EU country where you live or work.
privacy.analyticsBody: The purpose is to understand which content and services interest visitors and improve the website. The legal basis is your optional, revocable consent (GDPR Article 6(1)(a)). Google receives pseudonymous cookie identifiers, device and browser information, approximate location (down to city level, derived from the IP address, which Google Analytics does not store), visited pages, referral information and interactions. Contact clicks are grouped by area, service and email/WhatsApp channel: email contents and prefilled WhatsApp messages are not sent. A click does not prove an enquiry was sent. The site does not request advertising features or ad personalisation. Without consent the Analytics tag is not loaded.
privacy.storageBody: Your statistics choice is stored in your browser for six calendar months, with its date, expiry and notice version. Browsing alone does not renew it. The theme preference keeps your theme until you delete it; the language is not stored, as it depends on the page address. After consent, _ga and _ga_* cookies distinguish browsers and sessions; the site sets a 180-day lifetime without automatic renewal. User and event data in Google Analytics are retained for 2 months, without resetting retention on new activity. Deletion follows Google's monthly processing cycle. This limit does not apply to aggregated statistical reports, which remain available in the Analytics property while the controller maintains it.
privacy.recipientsBody: The controller accesses the statistics. The contractual provider of the standard service for Italy is Google Ireland Limited, processing data on the controller's behalf under the linked data processing terms. Google LLC and other subprocessors listed by Google may be involved. The service may involve transfers outside the European Economic Area: covered transfers to certified US recipients rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework adequacy decision; other transfers rely on the safeguards in Google's terms, including standard contractual clauses where applicable. For hosting and page delivery, browsing data are also received by GitHub, Inc. and Cloudflare, Inc., which also receives the statistics of visitors outside the European Union; emails pass through Cloudflare and are stored in Gmail (Google), under their respective terms; here too, transfers to the United States are possible, with the safeguards set out in their terms (EU-US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses). You can consult the safeguards below or ask the controller for information.
privacy.choicesBody: You can refuse statistics without losing access to content. Cookie preferences in the footer and on this page let you change your choice at any time. Rejecting after acceptance blocks new measurements, removes accessible Analytics cookies and reloads the page to deactivate code already loaded. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of earlier processing or automatically delete previously transmitted data. Your choice is shared only between tabs of the same browser and origin.
privacy.analyticsActive: Optional statistics are activated only after your consent.
privacy.dataInactiveBody: The site stores a technical preference for the theme in your browser; the language depends only on the page address and is not stored. Google Analytics is disabled. For visitors from a country outside the European Union, Cloudflare collects aggregated statistics without cookies, described below. There are no contact forms: email buttons open your mail application; WhatsApp buttons open a chat on WhatsApp, an external Meta service.
privacy.fontsInactiveBody: Fonts are hosted on this website. The Google Analytics tag is not loaded. For visitors from a country outside the European Union, Cloudflare adds its own statistics script, described above. External links lead to services with their own notices.
privacy.analyticsInactiveBody: Google Analytics is not active. No advance consent is requested for possible future activation. If activated, this notice will be updated and statistics can start only after an explicit choice.
privacy.storageInactiveBody: The theme preference is stored in your browser until website data are cleared, to remember your theme; the language is not stored, as it depends on the page address. Previous cookie choices may remain for their remaining lifetime and can be removed by clearing website data. The site does not set new Google Analytics cookies and removes accessible Analytics cookies when the page is opened.
privacy.recipientsInactiveBody: In this configuration no data are sent to Google Analytics. Processing for GitHub Pages hosting, for page delivery and statistics by Cloudflare (only for visitors outside the European Union) and for email or WhatsApp communications remains as described in the relevant sections. Google documentation links are provided for reference and do not load Analytics.
privacy.choicesInactiveBody: Cookie preferences lets you check that statistics are disabled. You can delete technical preferences in your browser settings. Deleting them restores the website's initial settings.
